    Modifier and Type
    Method
    Description
    static <T> SqlRowMapper<T>
    SqlRowMapper.bean(Class<T> type)
    A built-in row mapper that maps each row to a new instance of type: a record (via its canonical constructor) or a concrete class with a public no-arg constructor and public setters (setX/withX returning void or the bean type, so fluent setters work) or public non-final fields.
    static <T> SqlRowMapper<T>
    SqlRowMapper.bean(BeanMeta<T> beanMeta)
    Same as bean(Class), but follows the bean rules of existing bean metadata, for example the metadata of the serializer that renders the rows, so column names match the property names it emits.
    static SqlRowMapper<Map<String,Object>>
    SqlRowMapper.map()
    A built-in row mapper that maps each row to a new LinkedHashMap, keyed by the logical column name in SELECT order, with each value read via ResultSet.getObject(int) (the driver's natural type; null for SQL NULL).
